sloka: राक्षसेषु पिशाचेषु किन्नरेषु मृगेषु च ।दानवेषु च घोरेषु न स विद्येत शोभने ॥३-४५-१२॥
transliteration: rākṣaseṣu piśāceṣu kinnareṣu mṛgeṣu ca ।dānaveṣu ca ghoreṣu na sa vidyeta śobhane ॥3-45-12॥

translations.english: O brilliant Devi none among gods or men, gandharvas, birds or goblins kinnaras, wild animals or dreadful demons can encounter Rama in war.
